name: hustle-hub-plus-root
description: Shortcut scripts that run the api and client folders from the repository root.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix api && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.audit: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high --prefix api && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high --prefix client
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:client && npm run audit
